How it works: when you tap ▶ CC, Android asks to allow screen recording / casting. The app only uses it to hear the stream\'s sound — the screen is never recorded or sent anywhere. While subtitles are on, sound from other apps can be captured too, so tap ■ CC when you\'re done.
